title: stremioctl account snapshot v1
description: A private, atomic capture of the add-on collection returned by an authenticated `account pull`. This is a raw artifact: it holds transport URLs verbatim and is only ever written under a private directory with mode 0600. `collectionFingerprint` is the raw SHA-256 of the canonical `collection` array and is the value a later phase compares against a change plan's `baseCollectionFingerprint`.
